title: Medicine for {target}
Herbs, and haste
summary: There is sickness in {target}. Carry {giver}'s remedies there, {distance} to the {direction}, within {days} days.
offer: A fever's going through {target}. I've made up what remedies I can. Take them, please, and don't dawdle: two days, three at most.
complete: They'll live, then. You've done a kind thing.
